snippet.title: Abigail - Official Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Abigail, a narrative-driven adventure game developed by Hapshapen Games. Players will navigate a splintered friend group and explore vibrant, handcrafted neighborhoods, each with their unique way of playing the ubiquitous folk game Azulejo. Abigail is coming soon to PC (Steam).
